# Jubilees Chapter 28 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Jacob at Laban's house; marriage to Leah and Rachel

---

**28:1** And in the forty-third jubilee, in the second year of the first week, Jacob came to the land of the east, to Laban the brother of Rebekah his mother, and he was with him.

**28:2** And Laban said to him: "Thou shalt not serve me for nothing. Tell me what shall thy wages be?" And Jacob had not yet been with him a month.

**28:3** And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah and the name of the younger was Rachel. And Leah's eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful and fair of form.

**28:4** And Jacob loved Rachel, and said to Laban: "I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter."

**28:5** And Laban said to him: "It is better that I give her to thee than that I give her to another man. Abide with me."

**28:6** And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed to him but a few days, because of his love for her.

**28:7** And in the first year of the first week of the forty-fourth jubilee, Jacob said to Laban: "Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her."

**28:8** And Laban prepared a feast and took Leah his elder daughter and gave her to Jacob as wife. And Jacob came in to her, and he knew not that she was Leah.

**28:9** And in the morning it came to pass that behold, it was Leah. And Jacob said to Laban: "What is this that thou hast done to me? Did I not serve thee for Rachel? Why hast thou deceived me?"

**28:10** And Laban said: "In our place it is not done so, to give the younger before the elder. Complete the week of this one, and I will give thee also the other for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven more years."

**28:11** And Jacob did so and completed her week. And in the second year of the first week of the forty-fourth jubilee, he gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

**28:12** And Jacob came in also to Rachel, and he loved Rachel more than Leah. And he served with him yet seven other years.

**28:13** And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb. But Rachel was barren.

**28:14** And Leah conceived and bore a son, and called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year.

**28:15** And in the third year she bore Simeon. And in the fourth year she bore Levi. And in the fifth year she bore Judah.

**28:16** And Rachel saw that she bore no children to Jacob, and Rachel was jealous of her sister. And she said to Jacob: "Give me children, or else I die."

**28:17** And Jacob was angry at Rachel, and said: "Am I in the place of God who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?"

**28:18** And she said: "Here is Bilhah my handmaid; go in to her, that she may bear upon my knees, and I also may be built up through her."

**28:19** And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid as wife. And he came in to her, and she conceived and bore a son, and Rachel called his name Dan.

**28:20** And Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son, and Rachel called his name Naphtali.

**28:21** And when Leah saw that she had ceased bearing, she took Zilpah her handmaid and gave her to Jacob as wife. And Zilpah bore Jacob a son, and Leah called his name Gad.

**28:22** And Zilpah bore again, and Leah called his name Asher.

**28:23** And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest and found mandrakes in the field and brought them to Leah his mother. And Rachel said to Leah: "Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes."

**28:24** And she said to her: "Is it a small thing that thou hast taken my husband? And wouldst thou take also my son's mandrakes?" And Rachel said: "He shall lie with thee tonight in exchange for thy son's mandrakes."

**28:25** And Leah went out to meet Jacob in the evening when he came from the field, and said: "Thou must come in to me, for I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes." And he lay with her that night.

**28:26** And God hearkened to Leah, and she conceived and bore the fifth son. And Leah called his name Issachar.

**28:27** And Leah conceived again and bore the sixth son to Jacob, and called his name Zebulun.

**28:28** And Leah also bore a daughter and called her name Dinah.

**28:29** And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her and opened her womb. And she conceived and bore a son, and called his name Joseph.

**28:30** And in those days Rachel said: "God hath taken away my reproach." And she said: "The LORD add to me another son."

---

*EMET notes: The Jubilees account precisely dates the marriages and births by jubilee/week/year. The birth notices (vv.14-29) provide a more ordered birth sequence than Genesis 29-30. "Mandrakes" renders the Ge'ez term for the aphrodisiac plant (Hebrew duda'im). "Fruit of the womb" is literal for the Ge'ez compound.*
